safety_observation.name: safety_observation
safety_observation.description: A safety observation refers to the act of noticing and recording behaviors, conditions, or practices that impact workplace safety, whether positive or negative. In HSE, these observations are used to identify trends, reinforce safe practices, and address unsafe actions before they lead to incidents. They often include both compliance with and deviations from safety protocols.
examples: Observed worker wearing full PPE while operating forklift.
Noted that emergency exit was partially blocked by equipment.
Employee used proper lockout/tagout procedure during maintenance.
Found spill on walkway promptly cleaned up by staff.
Observed unsafe lifting technique in warehouse area.

incident.name: incident
incident.description: An incident in HSE refers to any unplanned event that results in or could result in injury, illness, property damage, or environmental harm. Incidents are formally reported and investigated to determine root causes and prevent recurrence. This category includes accidents, injuries, equipment failures, and other significant safety events.
examples: Worker suffered a laceration to hand while using box cutter.
Forklift collided with storage rack causing minor damage.
Chemical spill resulted in evacuation of production area.
Employee slipped on wet floor and sprained ankle.
Fire alarm triggered due to electrical short in panel.

near_miss.name: near_miss
near_miss.description: A near miss is an unplanned event that did not result in injury, illness, or damage but had the potential to do so. In HSE, near misses are critical for proactive risk management, as they highlight hazards and unsafe conditions before they cause harm. Reporting near misses helps organizations address underlying issues and prevent future incidents.
examples: Falling tool narrowly missed worker below, no injury occurred.
Forklift reversed into aisle but stopped just before hitting pallet.
Employee tripped over loose cable but regained balance.
Chemical container dropped but did not break or spill.
Overhead load swung out of control but was quickly stabilized.

hazard_report.name: hazard_report
hazard_report.description: A hazard report documents the identification of a condition, process, or behavior that poses a risk to health, safety, or the environment. In HSE, these reports are used to flag potential dangers so corrective actions can be taken before an incident occurs. Hazards can include physical, chemical, ergonomic, or environmental risks.
examples: Reported frayed electrical cord in break room.
Identified unguarded moving parts on conveyor belt.
Noted oil spill near loading dock creating slip hazard.
Flagged missing handrail on stairway.
Reported strong chemical odor in storage area.

environmental_observation.name: environmental_observation
environmental_observation.description: An environmental observation involves noting and recording conditions or events that may impact the environment, such as pollution, waste, emissions, or wildlife disturbances. In HSE, these observations help ensure compliance with environmental regulations and promote sustainable practices. They can include both positive and negative environmental behaviors or incidents.
examples: Observed oil sheen on surface water near outfall.
Noted proper segregation of hazardous waste containers.
Reported excessive dust emissions from construction site.
Spotted wildlife nesting near storage tanks.
Identified leaking valve causing minor chemical release.

maintenance_request.name: maintenance_request
maintenance_request.description: A maintenance request is a formal notification submitted to address equipment, facility, or infrastructure issues that may affect safety, health, or operational efficiency. In HSE, timely maintenance requests help prevent unsafe conditions, equipment failures, and potential incidents. These requests can be for repairs, replacements, or preventive maintenance.
examples: Requested repair of faulty emergency stop button on machine.
Submitted work order for leaking pipe in utility room.
Reported broken safety guard on conveyor belt for replacement.
Requested servicing of malfunctioning fire alarm system.
Notified maintenance of flickering lights in stairwell.
